fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.description: Identifies a vehicle, such as a bus or a train car. If possible, this should match other internal agency vehicle IDs and the GTFS-realtime VehicleDescriptor.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: The timestamp at which the vehicle is first in operation.

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: The timestamp at which the vehicle no longer exists.

fields.name: vehicle_label
fields.description: The public identifier that is shown on the vehicle (e.g., the bus number)

fields.name: license_plate
fields.description: There text of the license plate on the vehicle.

name: vehicles.schema.json
description: Vehicles, including buses and train cars, with descriptive information.
